headerDisplay: US MyNISSAN / Ariya. Sign in above. One accessory per vehicle; names do not affect pairing. Remote actions require Nissan service entitlement.

authFile.title: Absolute path to token file
authFile.description: Defaults to nissan-connect/auth.json inside Homebridge storage. File must be owned by the Homebridge user and readable only by that user.

staleAfter.title: Mark unavailable after no successful API read (seconds)

batteryThresholdIndicatorType.title: Battery threshold indicator type
batteryThresholdIndicatorType.description: How Battery Threshold Reached appears in Home. All types are read-only. Changing the type replaces only this service after restart; update automations that use it.

batteryThresholdRepeatOnIncrease.title: Repeat threshold trigger on each battery increase
batteryThresholdRepeatOnIncrease.description: While monitoring is enabled and the threshold is already met, briefly reset the indicator for each newly observed higher battery percentage. Outlets and switches turn off for one second then on; contact sensors close then reopen. Unchanged readings do not repeat.

includeLocation.title: Expose location and Locate Vehicle command

readOnly.title: Disable secure vehicle controls
readOnly.description: Enable for status-only use to prevent accidental vehicle actions from Home, Siri or automations. Blocks all commands sent to Nissan, including locking/unlocking, climate, charging, horn/lights, schedules and vehicle wake/refresh/location requests. Status polling and local battery threshold controls remain available. This does not restrict access outside your home network. Off by default.

name.title: Vehicle name
name.description: Change this and restart Homebridge to rename without changing accessory identity. Apple Home may retain its own name; edit that in Home.
